description: Bring the quote templates in line with their model quotes (each template names its AbaNinja quote in `quelle`, e.g. OF0001 — the model quotes are authoritative for prices). Copies price and quantity per article number onto the template lines; per-sample lines keep their quantity. Without apply=true it only lists the differences. Run sync_abaninja first so the quote positions are current.

apply.description: true = write the changes; default is a preview.

name: sync_offer_templates_from_abaninja
